meta.description: Draft prototype: rename, move and icon controls on the selected menu row. Installs the proto/selected-row-controls branch and lands in edit mode with ?maestro_rows=1.

steps.data:
<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Maestro demo user switcher
 * Description: Playground demo only. Adds a "Switch user" admin bar menu listing the demo users. Requires User Switching.
 */

add_action(
	'admin_bar_menu',
	static function ( WP_Admin_Bar $bar ) {
		if ( ! class_exists( 'user_switching' ) || ! is_user_logged_in() ) {
			return;
		}

		$current = wp_get_current_user();
		$users   = get_users(
			array(
				'login__in' => array( 'admin', 'editor', 'author', 'contributor', 'subscriber' ),
				'orderby'   => 'login__in',
			)
		);

		$items = array();
		foreach ( $users as $user ) {
			if ( $user->ID === $current->ID ) {
				continue;
			}
			$url = user_switching::maybe_switch_url( $user );
			if ( $url ) {
				$items[ $user->user_login ] = array( $user, $url );
			}
		}

		if ( ! $items ) {
			return;
		}

		$bar->add_node(
			array(
				'id'    => 'maestro-demo-switch',
				'title' => esc_html( sprintf( 'Viewing as %s', $current->display_name ) ),
			)
		);

		foreach ( $items as $login => $item ) {
			list( $user, $url ) = $item;
			$role               = $user->roles ? translate_user_role( wp_roles()->role_names[ $user->roles[0] ] ) : '';
			$bar->add_node(
				array(
					'parent' => 'maestro-demo-switch',
					'id'     => 'maestro-demo-switch-' . $login,
					'title'  => esc_html( 'admin' === $login && user_switching::get_old_user() ? sprintf( 'Switch back to %s', $user->display_name ) : sprintf( 'Switch to %s (%s)', $user->display_name, $role ) ),
					'href'   => $url,
				)
			);
		}
	},
	100
);

<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Maestro prototype: long menu name
 * Description: Playground demo only. A plugin-style menu with a long name, for checking the row controls at narrow widths.
 */
add_action( 'admin_menu', static function () {
	add_menu_page( 'Analytics', 'WooCommerce Marketing & Analytics Insights', 'manage_options', 'lab-long-name', '__return_null', 'dashicons-chart-area', 58 );
	add_submenu_page( 'lab-long-name', 'Reports', 'Customer Lifetime Value Reports', 'manage_options', 'lab-long-name-reports', '__return_null' );
} );
